title: What you hope, and what you doubt
description: Say what might happen, and what you are not sure about.

explanation.summary: Spanish has a mood for things that are not certain: what you hope for, what you doubt, what you want someone to do. It is called the subjunctive, and it is built by taking the yo form and swapping the ending.

sections.heading: How the forms are built
sections.body: Take the yo form of the present and give it the endings of tú: yo hablo becomes hable, yo como becomes coma, yo vivo becomes viva. The endings are -e, -es, -e, -emos, -éis, -en. The six irregular yo forms change irregularly too: tengo becomes tenga, vengo becomes venga, hago becomes haga, pongo becomes ponga, digo becomes diga, sé becomes sea.

examples.en: I do not think it is true.

sections.heading: The three triggers
sections.body: The subjunctive appears after: expressions of will or feeling (quiero que, espero que, me alegro de que), expressions of doubt (no creo que, dudo que, es posible que), and after certain conjunctions (cuando, aunque, para que, porque, antes de que). After these the verb is in the subjunctive even when the subject is the same person: quiero que vengas, even though you are the one speaking.

examples.en: When I arrive, I will call you.
Even if it is difficult, I will do it.

examples.es: Te lo digo para que lo sepas.
examples.en: I am telling you so that you know.

sections.heading: The same tense, the same word
sections.body: The present indicative and the present subjunctive have the same endings except for the yo form. That is why the yo form is the one that matters: hablo against hable. Learn the six irregular ones and the rest follows.

exercises.prompt: Pair each word with its translation.
exercises.note: The present subjunctive is the opposite of the yo form: hable, coma, viva.
The subjunctive of hablar. It is the opposite of the yo form.
The subjunctive of comer. It is the opposite of the yo form.

exercises.note: The present subjunctive is the opposite of the yo form: hable, coma, viva.
